method_scopes.rationale: The eCLIP card, collection-page heading and middle poster row identify the target as enhanced CLIP. All listed operations apply to this scoped 2016 implementation. The initial title icon is descriptive; neighboring miR-CLIP/irCLIP workflows, their adapter legends and right-side chemical structures do not belong to this route. Primary evidence resolves two distinct ligations around reverse transcription. The graph ends at physical cDNA, without asserting that sequencing has occurred. The primary implementation subsequently amplifies and sequences this material; paired-end RNA-derived sequences locate selected RBP-associated RNA and crosslink-associated cDNA ends, while the random-mer helps distinguish PCR duplicates. This does not establish perfect specificity or crosslink coverage. SMInput is a separately prepared background-normalization control; IgG was a tested control poorly suited to normalization. Neither control is a branch in these supplied depictions. ASO perturbations, knockdown/microarray assays and RNase-dose comparisons are validation experiments, not required operations in the depicted route. The broad purification block includes the primary paper-supported gel/membrane interface without adding its routine execution details.
